tagline.en: NVIDIA Cosmos Transfer 2.5 — a control-conditioned world model that steers video generation with spatial signals like edges, via a VACE branch.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA Cosmos Transfer 2.5——控制条件的世界模型,通过 VACE 控制分支用边缘等空间信号引导视频生成。

en: Cosmos Transfer 2.5 is the control-conditioned member of NVIDIA's Cosmos 2.5 world models. Instead of generating video from a prompt alone, it takes spatial control signals — such as edge maps and other conditioning modalities — and transfers them into a coherent generated video, useful for controllable simulation and world generation.

It shares the same native backbone as Predict 2.5 — the Reason1 conditioner, flow-UniPC scheduler, Wan VAE codec, and checkpoint loader — and adds a VACE control branch: a small set of control blocks attached to the base transformer plus a multi-modality control embedder. The 2B checkpoint is released under the NVIDIA Open Model License.
In WorldFoundry it runs through the shared native pipeline via the VACE recipe — supply your control input alongside a prompt and it produces the controlled video.
zh: Cosmos Transfer 2.5 是 NVIDIA Cosmos 2.5 世界模型中支持控制条件的成员。它不只依赖提示词生成视频,而是接收空间控制信号(如边缘图等条件模态),并把它们迁移成连贯的生成视频,适合可控仿真与世界生成。
它与 Predict 2.5 共享同一原生主干——Reason1 条件器、flow-UniPC 调度器、Wan VAE 编解码器与 checkpoint 加载器——并增加了 VACE 控制分支:在基础 transformer 上附加一小组控制块,以及一个多模态控制嵌入器。2B checkpoint 以 NVIDIA Open Model License 发布。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过统一原生 pipeline 以 VACE 方案运行:把控制输入与提示词一起给它,它便生成受控视频。

whenToUse.en: When you need controllable video generation guided by spatial signals such as edges — steering the output structure rather than relying on a text prompt alone — within the Cosmos world-model framework.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要由边缘等空间信号引导的可控视频生成——通过控制输出结构而非仅靠文本提示——并希望在 Cosmos 世界模型框架内完成时。

notFor.en: The control checkpoint is released under the NVIDIA Open Model License and downloaded separately, so plan for access. If you don't need spatial conditioning, Predict 2.5 covers plain text/image/video-to-world.
notFor.zh: 控制 checkpoint 以 NVIDIA Open Model License 发布并需单独下载,请预留访问权限。若不需要空间条件,Predict 2.5 即可覆盖普通的文本/图像/视频到世界生成。
